info.title: Wispel core API
info.description: Generated core contract snapshot from packages/shared. Covers web dashboard and iOS Phase 1 endpoints.

post.summary: Request a password-reset email (always 200; no email enumeration)
Reset password with a one-time token

get.summary: Read active Rustschild pause for a child

put.summary: Set or replace a per-child pause (parent full)

get.summary: List Taakvraag proposals (parent: all; child: own)

post.summary: Teen proposes a task (no ledger write)
Parent approves a Taakvraag into a real task
Parent declines a Taakvraag with a friendly note
Resolve a family code to child profiles
Rotate a child device refresh token

get.summary: Parent approval queue across dates (submitted instances, oldest first)

post.summary: Invite a co-parent (token delivered by email; not echoed in body)

get.summary: Mint a copyable invite URL (parent-only, rate-limited reveal)

post.summary: Attach a ready photo to an instance

get.summary: Read rewards and savings goal state
Read redemptions for the current viewer
List avatar cosmetic catalogue (progression unlocks, no IAP)
Read equipped + unlocked avatar state for a child

post.summary: Create a cooperative family goal (one active max)

get.summary: Active family goal progress (sum of earned points, no sibling ranking)

patch.summary: Archive or complete a family goal
